author: Yffe
content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_mutation.rs::divergence_weak_contract_escapes_floor_via_zero_scored_mutants demonstrates the divergence. Program: `fn pick(xs: &[u32]) -> &[u32] req xs.len() <= 10 ens result.len() <= 10 fx pure { xs }`. mutation::generate emits ZERO mutants (the early-return mutator is skipped for &[u32] because zero_value_for returns None, and the body has no Binary/IntLit/If site); MutationScore::kill_ratio returns 1.0 for scored==0 (mutation.rs), so the floor is vacuously met and the under-constraining contract certifies clean L3 with mutants_killed=0/0. Authority: thermite-design.md §7 step 4 (the floor must catch a contract that under-constrains the body) + goal.md R-DEFER-9 (anti-Goodhart). Root cause + owning crate: forge::mutation / forge::check::mutation_score. A fix likely makes the early-return mutant generatable for any return type (or treats 0/0 as not-certifiable rather than vacuous-pass).
